title: LiDAR Drone
tagline: 🥈 2nd place at LiU Game Awards 2025 — a Godot game built around LiDAR-based mechanics
description: A game developed for the TDDD23 game programming course at Linköping University. Selected as a finalist and awarded 2nd place at LiU Game Awards 2025, presented at East Sweden Game Summit.

title: Low-Latency Video Distribution
tagline: Real-time video streaming over Raspberry Pi nodes at Trafikverket R&D
description: Designed and implemented a low-latency video distribution system using Raspberry Pi devices. Evaluated transport protocols and video codecs to optimise real-time performance for Trafikverket's R&D lab.

title: PDF Knowledge Base + AI Chat
tagline: Full-stack Electron app with semantic search powered by a local LLM
description: Built a full-stack Electron and Python application with a PostgreSQL backend to scrape, organise, and serve PDF documents. Integrated an AI chatbot via Ollama for semantic search and question answering over the document corpus.
